systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé et de l'Hygiène publique, Direction de la planification, de la recherche et des statistiques (DPRS)

note: The only system named is a WHO analysis tool for mortality and cause-of-death data (training workshop, Dakar, 20-21 July 2026): one function, so no HMIS or EMR fact. The 'système d'information sanitaire' is mentioned only as something to be modernised.
